title: Story premise EDU026: The Two Endings Merge
summary: Idea-stage learning premise (computing/data). Hook: Which ending did we actually agree to keep? Takeaway/theme: Version control preserves change history; conflicting intent still needs a decision.
description: Two animators must combine edits to one story, but both changed the same final line. A branch diagram preserves their versions and highlights the conflict so they can choose a deliberate combined ending.
